metadata.name: Pricing Plan Tilt
metadata.description: Three pricing cards rendered as real 3D objects: they tilt with the cursor, carry a glare that follows it, and lift on hover. A running light circles the selected plan, and the monthly/yearly toggle is a springy pill with a bouncing Save badge.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
